item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President explains the factual and legal basis for the emergency action but does not, in this segment, direct an agency or itself make the operative nationwide emergency determination, which occurs in segment 2.","evidence":"It is therefore critical that we deploy all powers and authorities available to the Federal Government to provide needed relief."},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory nationwide emergency determination; FEMA assistance becomes legally available as a consequence, although its provision remains discretionary.","evidence":"I hereby determine, under section 501(b) of the Stafford Act, that an emergency exists nationwide."},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The FEMA Administrator is assigned coordination and direction of federal agencies, while the request to state and local governments is hortatory; no specified legal consequence is mandated.","evidence":"Administrator Gaynor shall coordinate and direct other Federal agencies in providing needed assistance under the Stafford Act"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President expects FEMA to conduct an internal review of possible assistance within existing authority, without dictating a particular legal outcome.","evidence":"I expect FEMA to continue to review all ways in which it can provide assistance to States"},{"segment_id":"5","code":2,"rationale":"The President directs the Treasury Secretary to grant affected Americans a specified later legal consequence—relief from tax deadlines—through statutory administration.","evidence":"instructing Secretary Mnuchin to provide relief from tax deadlines to Americans who have been adversely affected"},{"segment_id":"6","code":0,"rationale":"The President expresses a view, encourages nonfederal officials to submit requests, and states readiness to consider them; the segment neither governs an agency nor changes legal rights.","evidence":"I encourage all governors and tribal leaders to consider requesting Federal assistance"}]}
